aspect: It is a second injury with its own literature
description: Defined as wrongdoing perpetrated by an institution upon people dependent on it, including failure to respond supportively to wrongdoing committed within it. It harms pragmatically and psychologically, separately from the original event.
energy_note: The handling is its own wound.

description: Inquiry findings across institutional settings record bodies choosing to preserve the alleged perpetrator's reputation and their own above protecting those in their care, with concerns not escalated, information not shared, and policies in place but not upheld.
energy_note: The policy existed. Nobody followed it.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the HR outcome letter
description: 'The investigation was unable to substantiate the allegation. We consider the matter closed. We would remind you of your obligations of confidentiality.' Four months. Nobody interviewed the two people she named.
energy_note: Unsubstantiated, and the witnesses were never called.

aspect: The antidote is named and rarely chosen
description: Freyd's institutional courage - transparency, accountability, anonymous victimisation surveys, acting despite short-term cost. It exists as a programme and is adopted by a minority.
energy_note: There is a known remedy and it is optional.
